column6: Bullet 3 absolute "individual cells do not adapt on demand" is false (inducible resistance such as AmpC or vanA induction exists); reworded so heritable resistance spreads by selection
Arithmetic checked: 560x50=28,000; 240x1=240
Realized niche is generally smaller than fundamental was keyed false while its own explanation says true in most cases; key set to true, explanation prefixed
Industrial fixation exceeds all natural fixation is false (Haber-Bosch ~120 Tg N/yr vs ~200 natural incl. marine); changed to human fixation exceeds natural fixation on land
Same industrial-vs-all-natural overstatement; same fix
Only natural pathway ignored lightning; changed to "main natural pathway (lightning adds a small amount)"
Bullet 1 "Only common-garden, breeding, or parent-offspring studies can separate" is a false absolute and contradicts Explainer (twin studies); reworded as examples
Note: "In most lakes P is limiting" matches the file but N+P co-limitation is common (Elser et al. 2007); left as is
Worked a nested matrix: removing the top generalist orphans specialist plants, removing the specialist orphans none
Triploid cannot produce viable gametes is false (triploid bridge) and contradicts new bullet 3; changed to "produces few viable gametes"; also fixed typo Autopolyplody
Arithmetic checked: totals 70 and 130
Bullet 1 dropped qualifier: momentum growth holds only for young age structures; added it

Said protecting nesting beaches (adult females) beats hatcheries; Crouse et al. 1987 found the opposite, raising large-juvenile/adult survival at sea (TEDs) beats protecting eggs on beaches. Not changed: answer key (adults) is debatable for loggerheads, where large juveniles had the highest elasticity
Formula example used N=50 while the bead draw is 10 gene copies (N=5); changed to N=5, about 90% kept

Defined heterozygosity as "the frequency of the most common alleles"; changed to "which depends mostly on the common alleles". Not changed: q:0 keys "substantial" loss for one generation at Ne=50, which loses only ~1% heterozygosity and conflicts with new bullet 2; flag for review
Arithmetic checked: FST=0.64; Nm=1 gives 0.2
Bullet 2 absolute "Neither side gains a permanent victory"; some snake populations have outpaced newts (escape from the arms race); softened to "often ... rather than producing a clear winner"
Note: old q:2 (species-energy/solar energy, keyed false) has an explanation that does not show the statement false; flag for review

Step "check that each pair has existed before" fails when worked (A-b is new at lineage 1's first step); reworded to "each pair sits in a living genome, so selection tested it"; made third-locus step concrete (four untested pairs)
Note: old Core Idea/Explainer call sexual selection "a major mechanism for sympatric speciation" and the cichlid barrier "entirely" visual; both contested; left as is
Settles at 100, as dense as the source assumes equal patch areas; changed to "as many animals as the source holds". Arithmetic checked: 100, 80, 64, 51
Bullet 2 correctly hedges Yellowstone
Yellowstone riparian recovery stated as settled; added that its size and the role of wolves are debated
Yellowstone recovery stated as settled; hedged to "in some areas ... remain debated"
Worked tanks: green, clear, green, clear is right
Vegetation rebounded before elk numbers dropped via landscape of fear stated as settled; contested (e.g. Kauffman et al. 2010); hedged
Behavioral shift "responsible for much of the recovery" stated as settled; hedged. Question premise itself leans on the contested claim
Wolf restoration changed river channel morphology stated as settled; disputed; hedged and cut the "understatement" sentence
Broad Yellowstone effects stated as settled; changed to "reported effects ... several are debated"
Recovered dramatically ... altered the physical course of streams stated as settled; hedged
Arithmetic checked: 3% and 0.3%
